objective: Read-only dependency CVE audit with vulnerability database access

findings.vulnerability: customAlphabet/customRandom can loop indefinitely when called with size 0

validation.attacker_input: An attacker-controlled size value equal to 0
validation.sink: Unbounded generator loop causing denial of service
required_preconditions: A reachable caller uses customAlphabet or customRandom
project_evidence: No direct nanoid, customAlphabet, or customRandom reference was found in frontend source, scripts, or configuration
The package is a dev-only transitive dependency under PostCSS
No current application-runtime input path to the vulnerable API was demonstrated
validation.residual_risk: A future or hidden build-tool call path could become reachable; upgrade remains required for dependency hygiene

npm_feed_cvss.note: Registry feed did not provide a usable score/vector

findings.vulnerability: External sourceMappingURL processing without a from option can read an arbitrary .map file

validation.attacker_input: Untrusted CSS containing a crafted external sourceMappingURL
validation.sink: Local .map file read and potential disclosure during CSS processing
required_preconditions: The build pipeline processes attacker-controlled CSS
PostCSS is invoked without a from option
A readable target .map path is addressable from the build context
project_evidence: No direct postcss or sourceMappingURL reference was found in frontend source, scripts, or configuration
The package is reached through the Vite dev/build toolchain and is marked dev-only
The validated project build consumes repository-controlled frontend assets; no untrusted CSS ingestion path was identified
validation.residual_risk: Build or CI workflows that later ingest untrusted CSS could satisfy the advisory preconditions

source_reachability_check.scope: frontend excluding node_modules, dist, package-lock.json, and docs
source_reachability_check.nature: static bounded validation; no exploit proof-of-concept executed

raw_report_fingerprints.location: system temporary runtime; absolute path intentionally omitted

remediation.recommendation: In a separately authorized dependency change, regenerate the lock so PostCSS resolves to at least 8.5.23 and Nano ID 3.x resolves to at least 3.3.18, then rerun both audits, the guarded frontend regression, production build, and browser acceptance
remediation.compatibility_note: The existing semver ranges reported by the lock graph admit both patched versions; this audit did not mutate or install into the project

boundaries: A clean known-vulnerability result is database- and time-bounded and does not prove the absence of unknown vulnerabilities
An upstream advisory severity and a project-specific reachability assessment are separate claims
No unbounded-loop or arbitrary-file-read proof-of-concept was executed
This is not a repository-wide security scan, SBOM attestation, exploitability certification, production authorization, or provider/market validation
